capabilities: Show a calendar view in the sidebar
Open or create the daily note for a clicked date
Navigate between months and years via keyboard or mouse wheel
Sync selection between the calendar and daily notes
extras: The manifest description carries the note "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff."
intentEvidence: Just a calendar which works with the "daily notes" core plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view for browsing dates and jumping to or creating the matching daily note.

relations.evidence: Just a calendar which works with the "daily notes" core plugin.

summary: Calendar sidebar view that links dates to daily notes, with keyboard and scroll navigation between months and years.
